items.quote: the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelek, for they said, “He is related to us.”
items.contrast: The speakers are the citizens of Shechem, not the brothers who delivered the message.
items.reason: Although the brothers are a plausible antecedent from the preceding clause, “they said” explains why the citizens were inclined to support Abimelek, so the key correctly identifies the citizens.
